description: Source code for XNNPack graph builder in PyTorch JIT backend, including graph optimization, node and tensor definition, and runtime execution.

classes.name: XNNGraph
classes.description: Class responsible for building, optimizing, and executing XNNPack graphs within PyTorch JIT backend.

methods.name: optimizeAndTraceGraph
methods.description: Optimizes and traces a given graph with example inputs.

methods.name: buildXNNGraph
methods.description: Builds the XNNPack subgraph from a traced and optimized graph.

methods.name: runGraphOnInputs
methods.description: Runs the built XNNPack graph on provided tensor inputs and outputs.

methods.name: checkOpsToDelegate
methods.description: Checks the graph for unsupported operations before delegation.

methods.name: serializedXNNGraph
methods.description: Serializes the XNNPack graph into a string format.

methods.name: getGraphOutputShapes
methods.description: Returns the output shapes of the graph.

methods.name: defineAllNodes
methods.description: Defines all nodes in the graph for XNNPack.

methods.name: defineAllTensorValues
methods.description: Defines all tensor values in the graph for XNNPack.

methods.name: gatherTensorValues
methods.description: Gathers tensor values from the graph inputs, outputs, and nodes.

methods.name: gatherNodeInputs
methods.description: Gathers input tensors for a specific node.

methods.name: isGraphInput
methods.description: Checks if a value is a graph input.

methods.name: isGraphOutput
methods.description: Checks if a value is a graph output.
